messages:
Lena: Starting a micro-thread to capture a tiny customer-facing priming cheat-sheet for the 'pilot-phase' onboarding. Goal: keep CS steps minimal, ensure model warmness, and surface 7-day renewal soft signals.
Carlos: Love the idea. Keep it as 1 PDF + checklist in kickoff doc. Also add a tiny ops appendix for eng.
Dee: Suggestion: two-step warm path - 1) client-side cache for identical queries, 2) lightweight server prefill for top 10 intents during first 48h.
Rohit: +1. Add heartbeat pings from client every 30s during ramp so we can keep KV caches alive. If heartbeat fails 3x, mark session as cold and trigger a light prefill.
Lena: Good. Also: telemetry to capture: unique_sessions, avg_tokens_per_session, failed_stream_pct, and nps_48h. Keep metrics simple.
Carlos: Renewal signal idea: compute a 0-100 score: usage_factor(0-0.6) + satisfaction_factor(0-0.3) - friction_penalty(0-0.1). Flag <45 for early outreach. Keep the math easy to explain.
Dee: Ops appendix snippet (example curl probe):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/probe -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt": "hi"}' | jq '.latency, .status'
```
Rohit: Routing note: if customer reserved qps > 80% sustained for 10m, flip to burst mode and route to dedicated pool. Also include a manual override for CS.
Lena: Hand-off checklist for CS (4 boxes):
- [ ] Upload 5 canonical prompts
- [ ] Confirm NPS ping at 48h
- [ ] Schedule prefill window (1-2 hours before go-live)
- [ ] Verify refresh token and region selection
Carlos: Troubleshooting short list for customers: streaming dropout -> check client timeout (increase to 120s), stale refresh token, CORS issues, or region mismatch.
Dee: Small config preview we can send customers (YAML):
```yaml
warmup:
  client_cache: true
  seed_prompts: 10
  heartbeat_s: 30
  prefill_window_mins: 90
alerts:
  latency_median_ms: 500
  error_rate_pct: 2.0
```
Rohit: Keep rollback steps simple: 1) disable streaming on customer route, 2) switch to cached-variant, 3) increase logging and notify CS channel.
Lena: Action items: @Carlos write the 1-page cheat-sheet + attach the YAML and curl probe. @Dee craft the CS checklist wording. @Rohit add routing and escalation bullets. I will merge to playbook repo after review.
remind-bot: Reminder set - /remind @Carlos to upload cheat-sheet on 2026-04-01 10:00 PDT.
Carlos: Got it. I'll draft and post in this thread by tomorrow noon.
Lena: Thanks team. We'll keep the public-facing doc very short and point power-users to the ops appendix for details. :white_check_mark:
